lines.en: I scatter confetti as I walk

lines.zh: 海滩的沙子进了鞋，我不管
lines.en: Sand gets in my shoes, I do not care

lines.zh: 我蹦着走，裙角都是彩带
lines.en: I bounce along, ribbons on my hem
People look at me wherever I go

lines.zh: 海风把我的帽子吹歪了
lines.en: The sea wind knocks my hat askew

lines.zh: 我踩着水线走，鞋都湿了
lines.en: I walk along the waterline, shoes soaked

lines.zh: 我手里的烟花筒一晃一晃
lines.en: The firework tube sways in my hand
I circle the little stall once

lines.zh: 沙滩上的脚印，一大一小
lines.en: Prints in the sand, one big one small

lines.zh: 我朝谁都点头，哪怕不认识
lines.en: I nod at everyone, even strangers

lines.zh: 我往前走，纸屑就往后飘
lines.en: I walk forward and the confetti drifts behind

lines.zh: 海边风大，彩带缠在手上
lines.en: The wind is strong, ribbons wrap my hand

lines.zh: 我站在摊子后面，等着人
lines.en: I stand behind the stall, waiting
The firework tubes are lined up neatly
I count today's emeralds
The beach sun is strong
The ribbon on my brim has come loose again.

lines.zh: 有人在放烟花，我抬头看
lines.en: Someone is setting off fireworks, I look up

lines.zh: 我这份买卖，卖的是热闹
lines.en: What I sell is festivity
I shake the sand off my dress
There is a boat out there, I watch a while

lines.zh: 我的摊子不能少一件东西
lines.en: My stall cannot be missing a single item
After dark is when it gets good
I keep waiting for a regular

lines.zh: 我把纸屑从头发里抖出来
lines.en: I shake confetti out of my hair

lines.zh: 这顶帽子是我自己缝的
lines.en: I sewed this hat myself
You came! What will it be today
Your outfit is far too plain

lines.zh: 我这儿有烟花，你眼睛会亮
lines.en: I have fireworks, they will light up your eyes
Would you like to try this one
Stand there, let me look at you

lines.zh: 海滩上的风把你头发吹乱了
lines.en: The sea wind has mussed your hair

lines.zh: 我认得你的脸，你上次来过
lines.en: I know that face, you came before

lines.zh: 你笑了，比我这儿的烟花亮。
lines.en: You smiled, brighter than my fireworks.
I only take emeralds here

lines.zh: 你手里那点钱，够买一支
lines.en: That much will buy one tube
No need to be shy, look around
Wait, let me find a big one
My hat is crooked

lines.zh: 我坐在地上，纸屑沾了一身
lines.en: I sit on the sand, covered in confetti
The firework tubes rolled everywhere
Keep your hands off the goods
I am not one to cry, but it hurts
A tear in my dress
I step back and hold the stall
You have ruined a day's trade
I cannot even smile now
This one I am keeping a note of
Hand it here, let me see
Emeralds? I take those
That is not worth one firework
What would you like in exchange
I do not bargain, I deal in festivity
Why is your hand reaching so far
Not quite enough, add a little
Deal! Take it, do not drop it
I will put this in the cabinet first
Bring something rare next time
You stepped on my dress

lines.zh: 我退了一步，纸屑飞起来
lines.en: I step back and confetti flies up
Careful, there are fireworks set up here
One bump and the stall tilts
I steadied the firework tubes
Do not crowd in front of the stall

lines.zh: 海滩上地方大，你别贴着我
lines.en: The beach has room, do not press against me
That knocked my hat off

lines.zh: 我笑着躲开，其实有点气
lines.en: I dodge with a smile, a little annoyed
Bump again and the fireworks will roll
I am a person who celebrates every day

lines.zh: 我这儿热闹，你要待就待
lines.en: It is lively here, stay if you like
You do not even have emeralds
The stall cannot be left unwatched

lines.zh: 你别站那么近，我得招呼客人
lines.en: Do not stand so close, I have customers

lines.zh: 我这份热闹，不是谁都能跟
lines.en: Not everyone can keep up with my kind of fun
There are fireworks tonight, watch first
I like people who laugh
You have stood here quite a while
Let me tend to that side first

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起来，裙角拖在沙上
lines.en: I bend to pick it up, my hem in the sand
This fell in front of the stall
I blow the sand off it
Could this serve as a firework tube
I put it back in the crate
Dropped is dropped, it is worth little
This is mine, I know it
Whoever dropped it, come get it

lines.zh: 我手上拿着东西，你帮我捡
lines.en: My hands are full, help me pick it up

lines.zh: 海滩上什么都会被沙埋
lines.en: On this beach the sand buries everything

lines.zh: 有人来了，我先把烟花收一收
lines.en: Someone is coming, let me put the fireworks away
I look up and the smile drops

lines.zh: 摊子后头是我全部家当。
lines.en: Everything I own stands behind this stall.

lines.zh: 海滩上这个点不该有人
lines.en: Nobody should be here at this hour

lines.zh: 我把绿宝石盒塞进围裙
lines.en: I tuck the emerald box into my apron
Which way did you come from

lines.zh: 我这人不会打架，可我不傻
lines.en: I cannot fight, but I am not stupid
I step behind the stall
The sand here is all soft
Are you buying, or something else

lines.zh: 我手边有一支还没点的
lines.en: I have one here not yet lit
It gets dark quickly, you should go

lines.zh: 我瞧见你的手往箱子探。
lines.en: I see your hand straying toward the crate.
There is nothing of value here
The fireworks are still in the crate

lines.zh: 你再往前就踩着我的货。
lines.en: One more step and you are on my goods.

lines.zh: 我一直看着你，别再靠近
lines.en: I keep watching you, no closer

lines.zh: 摊子后面没路，可我不会跑
lines.en: No way out behind the stall, and I will not run

lines.zh: 我手里这支，点了就热闹
lines.en: This one in my hand would be lively if lit
There is no cover on this beach
I have to protect my goods

lines.zh: 你的眼睛一直往箱子上看
lines.en: Your eyes keep going to the crate
You cannot run fast on sand
I hear every step you take
The door behind me is shut
The light is failing

lines.zh: 我在这儿做了很久的买卖
lines.en: I have traded here a long while
A customer would not stand like that
I put my hand in the crate

lines.zh: 再往前一步，我就不客气
lines.en: One more step and I stop being nice
The surf covers other sounds
Glance behind you

lines.zh: 我不会喊，喊也没人听见
lines.en: I will not shout, nobody would hear
I throw the firework tube at you
That was a stiff paper tube, not light
I shove your chest
I have you backed to the edge of the surf.
I step on your foot
This one is still lit, keep back
Confetti and sand fly together
The smoke has got your throat
I drag the stall back
That made you draw your hand in
The firework bursts at your feet

lines.zh: 你要是不走，我就全点了
lines.en: Stay and I light them all
I am not to be trifled with
You stepped back, good

lines.zh: 我在海滩上支起了摊子
lines.en: I have set up my stall on the beach
The firework tubes stand ready
This spot is good, plenty of people
I put on my hat and smile
Confetti scattered everywhere
My stall is open
The emerald box sits within reach
The wind snaps the ribbons
Someone is looking over from afar
Today I want a full house
A bright cloth has appeared on the sand
I clap twice to draw people over
There will be light here tonight

lines.zh: 我把货物摆得整整齐齐
lines.en: I lay the goods out neatly
I wave at you, smiling
The sun is going, perfect

lines.zh: 火烧到我的裙子，边上卷了
lines.en: Fire caught my dress and the edge curled

lines.zh: 我从摊子上摔下来，沙子进了鞋
lines.en: I fell off the stall, sand in my shoes

lines.zh: 海浪把我卷住了，站不稳
lines.en: The surf caught me and I could not stand
My fireworks all went off at once

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的彩带
lines.en: An arrow went through my ribbons

lines.zh: 那股力气把我身上的颜色都洗淡了
lines.en: That force washed the color out of me
I worked all day without a bite

lines.zh: 雷打在海面上，我整个人都白了
lines.en: Lightning hit the water and I went white

lines.zh: 这里没有海滩，也没有人
lines.en: No beach here, and no one
